scenes.summary: After following Chen Qianyu to Hongshan Swordmancers, you meet Lian Xiaowu, who demonstrates gear artificing techniques.

lines.text: Chen? Took you some time to show up, huh? I've got so many good things here, you really can't afford to miss them!
Done with your duties over at Fangyi's?
Yup! We came straight over as soon as we finished!
Then you came at the perfect time! I just finished forging a batch. Chen, want to try that thing?
Hmm? You actually finished that thing?
Haha, my apologies. We're talking about ⟦key|gear artificing⟧.
Back when Hongshan Swordmancers and Endfield Industries were working together on weapons research, we tried a few things.
I was inspired and came up with my own method for modifying gear. It's still in the testing phase and only works on top-quality gear.
It's not ready for large-scale use yet, but it works perfectly for personal gear customization.
Ohhhh, I think the Endfield Crisis Team could really benefit from this! Alright, go ahead and enlighten us!
*Chuckle* Aren't you the sneaky one! Just got back and already eyeing my stuff!
Lucky for you, I prepared some ⟦key|test samples⟧. I'll show you right now.
Hehe, thank you, Xiaowu!
Mmm-hmm. Fangyi mentioned that the Endfield Crisis Team would be here any moment.
Not long after I read her message, you showed up...
Anyway, select the ⟦key|gear for artifice⟧, choose another ⟦key|piece of the same type as material⟧, add ⟦key|Artificing Catalyst⟧, and then just wait.
It's actually not that complicated. Give it a shot.

options: Don't keep me in the dark...
Wait, did you know we were coming?
Okay, let's try it out now.

scenes.summary: You have learned gear artificing. Lian Xiaowu reminds you that your first artificing attempt might not succeed, but doing it again and again will completely artifice your gear eventually.

lines.text: Not bad, Endmin! You're a quick learner.
If I hadn't seen it myself, I wouldn't believe it's your first time artificing gear!
*Sigh* Unlike my other students ... most of them have to make multiple artificing attempts before they could arrive at anything even mildly satisfactory.
It's alright if it doesn't work on your first try. Every drop of rain shall merge into a river. Try and try again till completion comes your way.
Hehe, with gear artificing under our belts, we'll never be short on good gear again!
Ah, speaking of gear... Endmin, how's that project going?
Oh, no biggie. It's nothing important. Once the project is done, I'm sure operators at Endfield will report to you.
You must still have business to attend to, so I won't keep you.
Come find me when you're free. I've got plenty more good stuff here.
